name: sql_composer
goal: After an explicit no-governed-match route, retrieve reviewed evidence, compose by reuse then adaptation then constrained generation, and return only a fully evidenced composition with a valid verification token.
human_checkpoints: Only a person may promote generated or adapted SQL into the query repository.
A failed verification or absent governed route is escalated; the agent never weakens policy.
never: Never executes SQL, calls ask, uses a human_only tool, promotes an exemplar, composes after a governed answer or clarification, or returns without path provenance and a verification token.
